task_language: Put the cream cheese on the rack
strategy_notes: Localized the blue cream-cheese box from agentview_high and wrist view near xy around [-0.04, 0.13]; localized the wooden rack by RGB as the tan slatted fixture beside the cabinet, then sampled the upper red/top ridge in agentview_high at pixels near [189,116], [214,132], [246,180], whose valid support lay around x -0.20 to -0.24, y -0.25 to -0.30, z about 1.18 to 1.21. Winning sequence after the final reset: move open over the box at [-0.04,0.12,1.12]; run pi0_pick `pick up the cream cheese` with max_chunks 20, lift_thresh 0.05, gripper_closed_thresh 0.06; firm with set_gripper +1 for 10 steps; carry held to high rack-ridge staging [-0.22,-0.08,1.28]; call pi0_doubled `put the cream cheese on the top of the wooden rack` for 12 chunks while still holding, which moved the held box directly over the wooden slats/top rack surface; release with max_steps 100, which fired termination after 8 steps.

top_rack_contact_step38.note: The contact step did not itself terminate but visually moved the held box onto the rack surface; the subsequent release step terminated.
